name: Naitou Manosuke
source:
Bronco Knight is the revolver-toting second-in-command of the Zheng Fa president's personal bodyguards. He was present during the apparent assassination attempt that was made against the president at Gourd Lake.

Knight is an arrogant man with a love of chess. He often uses chess metaphors and refers to himself as a "knight" protecting his "king".

Another obvious quirk of Knight's is his habit of playing with his revolver; he'll often twirl it around his finger, reload it for no reason, and even point it other people when talking to them.

[Edited from [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Manosuke_Nait%C5%8D]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
